commits.message:
[Test][Misc] Replace HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE with ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM in DeepSeek-V3.1T configs (#13857)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR replaces the `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE` environment variable with
`ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM` in 5 DeepSeek-V3.1T YAML configurations.
These configurations represent A3 HCCS scenarios (`npu_per_node: 16`)
which should utilize the fabric memory path for optimal performance.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No.

### How was this patch tested?

Tested via existing E2E weekly multi-node tests.

- vLLM version: v0.26.0

- vLLM main: vllm-project/vllm@0351e9a

Signed-off-by: lizy124 <1950471827@qq.com>

commits.comment: 量化方案的大规模清理与重构。移除了 AscendW4A8DynamicLinearMethod（W4A8 Linear）和 AscendW8A8PDMixFusedMoeMethod（W8A8 PDMix MoE），理由是该临时方案无演进计划、性能差且维护成本高。AscendW4A8DynamicFusedMoEMethod 被大幅简化：仅支持 per-channel 权重（group_size>0 时直接抛 ValueError），删除旧版 quant_version != "1.0.0" 的两步量化和 per-group scale_second 支持，将 pack/scale 处理收敛为 _pack_to_int32、_process_scale、_pack_int4_to_int8 三个辅助方法。COMPRESSED_TENSORS_METHOD 路径也同步收敛为 per-channel。同时更新了 docs、示例脚本中的量化配置（strategy: channel）、模型列表和测试。注意 build_weight 中 COMPRESSED_TENSORS_METHOD 仍返回 [E, 2*IN, H] 的未打包 int8 weight，而 modelslim 返回 [E, IN, H] 的已打包格式，两者的下游处理分支（compressed_tensors 多一步 _pack_int4_to_int8）保持区分，逻辑正确。潜在影响是依赖旧 W4A8 权重格式的存量用户需要重新量化模型。

test_impact.reason: 已同步更新测试：删除了 tests/ut/quantization/methods/a2/test_w4a8.py（487 行线性+MoE 混合测试），新建 tests/ut/quantization/methods/test_w4a8.py 仅覆盖 MoE 路径，并新增 per-group 拒绝测试；test_w8a8_pdmix.py 也删除了 MoE 部分。但仍需关注：模型数据集列表从 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-quantized.w4a8 切换到 Qwen3-30B-A3B-quantized.w4a8，nightly e2e 的模型权重已更换，需要确认新权重可用性和精度基线。

[Refactor][quantization]Remove deprecated W4A8Linear/W8A8PDMixMoE schemes and sync W4A8 MoE refactor (#13713)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

- Part of https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/13318

Some quantization modes are sunset in this PR, including

- W4A8 Linear
- W4A8 Per-Group MoE(2 weight formats)
- W8A8 PDMix MoE

The reasons are as follows:
- It was a temporary solution and will not have any new evolution plan
in the future.
-    The performance is poor, and there are better alternatives.
- The application scope is small, and the maintenance difficulty is
increased.

no

commits.comment: fused MoE 运行时契约的简化重构。核心变化：(1) 删除 FusedMoEResult dataclass，forward_impl 改为返回 (routed_out, FusedMoEEvents) 元组；(2) log2phy 不再作为参数在 build_fused_experts_input 中传递，而是统一在 AscendRoutedExperts._select_experts 内对 topk_ids 做映射，消除了 builder 调用点的大量重复逻辑；(3) shared expert 的 swiglu_limit/alpha/beta 参数从 FusedMoEEvents 中移除，改由 AscendSharedExperts 在 __init__ 时从 moe_config 读取并缓存，解决了事件对象与参数生命周期耦合的问题；(4) 删除 zero_experts_compute 相关代码，简化路由校验；(5) AscendRoutedExperts 不再通过构造参数接收 router，改由 AscendMoERunner.__init__ 设置 self.routed_experts.router = router，并通过 register_ascend_customop 注册 MoERunner/RoutedExperts（含 310P 分支），patch_fused_moe.py 相应移除动态类选择逻辑。重构后 310P 的统一注册路径更清晰。注意行为变化：log2phy 映射从 token_dispatch 前移动到 _select_experts 中，需确保 eplb_state 更新的统计口径仍使用映射前的 topk_ids（代码中在映射后仍通过 try 块调用 record_local_expert_load，需确认其参数来源），另外 Qwen3DSpark 的 confidence_head 缺失时从抛 RuntimeError 改为静默禁用，提升了健壮性但可能掩盖配置错误。

test_impact.reason: 测试已同步适配：test_fused_moe.py 中 FusedMoEResult 改为 (routed_out, FusedMoEEvents) 元组断言，_select_experts 测试改为通过 get_moe_num_logical_experts mock 替代原先的 zero_expert 断言；test_moe_runtime_args.py 移除 log2phy 参数验证；_310p 测试也适配了 FusedMoEEvents 结构化。但这次改动涉及 log2phy 应用时机的移动（从 comm method 前移到 router），现有单测 monkeypatch 了 get_forward_context 和 get_moe_num_logical_experts，建议补充一个集成级测试验证 log2phy 映射后 topk_ids 与 expert 统计的一致性，以及 zero expert 移除后与上游 FusedMoE 的 num_logical_experts 校验兼容性。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/routed_experts.py（新增 log2phy 映射后的 eplb 统计测试）

[Refactor][Ops] Simplify fused MoE runtime contracts (#13759)

## What this PR does / why we need it?

Simplify the fused MoE runtime contract by removing redundant dynamic
EPLB and log2phy plumbing from builder call sites, moving shared-expert
SwiGLU clamp parameters onto the shared expert executor, and updating
routed and quantized paths plus tests to match the streamlined
interface.

Remove  zero experts code in longcat.

## Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. This is an internal refactor of the fused MoE runtime contract and
its test coverage.

## How was this patch tested?

- git diff --check
- Local review of the affected fused MoE runtime and test updates

- vLLM version: v0.26.0
- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/0351e9aa1fdf1a51329d1906881528dfe61fc88e

---------

Signed-off-by: weijinqian0 <1184188277@qq.com>

commits.comment: 全仓库日落 ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL 环境变量。按硬件和部署路径分别替换为 ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM=1（A3 fabric memory 统一寻址直传）或 HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1（RoCE 路径），涉及 kv_pool 特性文档、Mooncake PD 分离部署教程、DeepSeek-V3.1/Kimi-K2.5/K2.6/K2.7 模型部署文档，以及 25+ 个测试配置文件。此前 ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL 是 A3 上不支持 fabric memory 时的 fallback 缓冲区方案，现在硬件与 CANN 版本成熟后直接启用更优的直传路径。变更覆盖面广但均为机械替换，方向与 d2e818f 一致。需要注意部分配置（如 QWEN3_235B_PD）启用了 ASCEND_A3_ENABLE + VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FUSED_MC2 又加 fabric mem，需确认组合场景下 Mooncake 与 MC2 的共存无冲突。

test_impact.reason: 虽然所有 ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL 出现点均已替换，但替换后的环境变量在不同硬件（A2 RoCE vs A3 fabric）下语义不同，需确保对应测试配置运行在正确硬件路径上。例如 single_node 的 test_qwen3_30b_acc.py 改为 ASCEND_ENABLE_USE_FABRIC_MEM=1，若 CI 跑在 A2 上可能不生效或不必要。建议在测试基础设施层增加对环境变量与硬件类型匹配性的校验或注释说明。

[Doc] Sunset ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL environment variable (#13820)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Sunsets the `ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL` environment variable across the entire
repository (docs, tutorials, locale translations, and test
configurations).

Yes. `ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL` is removed and replaced by

on the hardware and deployment path.

Verified zero remaining `ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL` occurrences across the
entire repository. Updated e2e multi-node and single-node test
configurations.
